The Co-rich CCIMA with a nominal composition of (Co47 Ni30 Al10 V5 Ta4 Ti4 )99 B1 (at.%) was prepared by a mixture of high-purity materials ( > 99.9 %) in an arc-melting furnace under an argon atmosphere

was prepared by a mixture of high-purity materials ( > 99.9 %) in an arc-melting furnace under an argon atmosphere, as detailed in a prior study [ 13 ]. To ensure chemical homogeneity, all ingots were turned over and repeatedly melted at least eight times, and then cast into a water- cooled Cu mold to form plate samples.
The as-cast specimens were homogenized at 1150 °C for 24 h under argon protection.
